# Corona

**Status: DRAFT** · world: [primigenia](../lore/worlds/primigenia.md) · kind: new · stage: creature · id: `corona`

## Niche

- **Habitat:** Sunken lava tube cave (tidal zone)
- **Diet:** Drifting carcass particles, zooplankton, small benthic invertebrates
- **Active:** Tidal (feeds on flood, rests on ebb/slack)
- **Predators:** none

## Body

Low-slung radial disc with six frilled arms, ciliated sensory margins, thick protective mucus coat

**Temperament:** Passive, reactive, highly sensitive to flow changes
